faq.headline: Restaurant Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your restaurant site.

items.question: Can guests reserve a table online?
items.answer: You can collect reservation enquiries or link to an existing booking service. A live table inventory and confirmation system is not included here.

items.question: Can customers order delivery?
items.answer: Online ordering and fulfilment require a separate working commerce flow; this page does not promise them.

items.question: Can I show different lunch and dinner menus?
items.answer: Yes. Organise menu sections around the meals you serve and update them as they change.

items.question: Can I show separate menus for meals or dietary needs?
items.answer: Yes. Organise the menu into sections such as lunch, dinner, or drinks, and publish dietary or allergen details only when your restaurant has verified them.

items.question: Can guests make a confirmed table reservation?
items.answer: The site can collect a reservation enquiry or link to an existing booking provider. A live table inventory and reservation confirmation flow are not included here.

items.question: Can customers order takeaway or delivery?
items.answer: Online ordering requires a working checkout and fulfilment flow. This page can present the menu and contact details but does not include that ordering system.
